notes: No objective is in the posted list, though the strategy ('Start with the regular Step stuff') and title make it a Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough deck; the objective is not added. The posted list totals 60 without it.

Starting cards are not marked in the post. Watch Your Step deploys the Cantina, Docking Bay 94 and Tatooine, all in the list; Tatooine: Cantina is set as the starting location. Heading For The Medical Frigate (listed under Interrupts) is the starting interrupt; the strategy says to start Insurrection, Staging Areas and Menace Fades, so no single starting Effect is set. All count toward the 60.
Posted 'Tatooine' dested the Light Premiere system; 'Docking Bay 94' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Cantina' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace).
